says: In next/, when the brain answers a hands client's jobs.finish refused unavailable and the client then crashes before it sends the same finish again, the requester's wake is never retried: the job is already finished, so it is no longer listed, and the client never sends that finish again.
proof: gateway/Gateway.ts:1198 answers unavailable only after jobs.finish saved the result (slice 3's W1), so the job is finished at the brain. client/HandsMachine.ts:343 keeps the result in memory and sends the same finish again after a backoff, which is the only retry of the wake. After a crash the client starts from the journal, whose last entry for the job is result, not acknowledged, and finds its work only through jobs.list, which answers open jobs only (jobs/JobsLedger.ts:89, requested, assigned or started), so the finished job never comes back and nothing sends the finish again.
cost: The program that asked the hands waits for a result that is saved but whose wake never lands, until something else wakes it; no error is shown.
